biography: Gustavo Frigotto's journey began amidst the sun-drenched karting tracks of São Paulo. His father, a former mechanic, instilled a love for speed and precision from a young age. Gustavo was barely tall enough to reach the pedals when he started tearing up the local circuits, quickly earning a reputation for his uncanny ability to read the track. A pivotal moment came during a national karting championship; battling for the lead, his kart suffered a mechanical failure. Undeterred, Gustavo pushed the kart across the finish line, securing a handful of points that ultimately contributed to him winning the title. This unwavering determination caught the eye of RKL Competicoes, who signed him to their development program. Now at 25, Gustavo is considered to be in his racing prime, continuing to hone his skills with RKL Competicoes, striving to make his mark on the international racing scene.
drivingStyle: Gustavo is known for his smooth, calculated driving style. He doesn't often overdrive the car, instead relying on precise inputs and exceptional car control to maintain momentum. His approach to corners is methodical, preferring to set up early and carry speed through the apex. Tire management is a key strength, allowing him to consistently deliver strong finishes even in races where others struggle with degradation. Under pressure, Gustavo remains remarkably calm, rarely making rash decisions and often capitalizing on the mistakes of his rivals.
